recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Whisk all ingredients together into a smooth batter. Pour onto a hot greased skillet and cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
recipes.instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through, slice it, and toss with chopped vegetables. Drizzle with olive oil and season to taste.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente. Saute sliced garlic in olive oil until golden, add chili flakes, then toss with pasta and parsley.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok, add garlic, then stir fry chopped vegetables on high heat for 5-6 minutes. Add soy sauce and toss to coat.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.instructions: Combine oats, milk, chia seeds and honey in a jar. Refrigerate overnight. Top with sliced banana before eating.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.instructions: Brown the ground beef with taco seasoning. Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, tomato, and cheese.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.instructions: Spread tomato sauce over the dough, add mozzarella, and bake at 220C for 12-15 minutes. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.instructions: Layer yogurt, granola, and berries in a glass. Drizzle honey on top before serving.

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
recipes.instructions: Saute onion, carrots and garlic. Add lentils, broth, and cumin. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft, then blend partially if desired.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.instructions: Marinate and sear chicken. Simmer pureed tomatoes with spices and butter, blend into smooth gravy, stir in cream, fenugreek, and cooked chicken.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.instructions: Blend sauteed onion, tomatoes, and soaked cashews into a rich puree. Cook with butter, spices, and add paneer cubes.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
recipes.instructions: Prepare spiced mashed potato filling with mustard seeds and onions. Spread batter thin on hot griddle, crisp it up, add filling, and roll.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.instructions: Blanch and blend spinach. Saute aromatics, add spinach puree and spices, simmer gently, then fold in paneer cubes.

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
recipes.instructions: Pressure cook soaked chickpeas with spicy onion-tomato gravy. Knead flour with yogurt, roll into discs, and deep-fry puffed bhature.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
recipes.instructions: Boil toor dal with turmeric and salt. Prepare aromatic tadka by sizzling cumin, garlic, and chilies in ghee, then pour over dal.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken in spiced yogurt. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices. Layer meat, fried onions, herbs, and rice, then slow steam on dum.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
recipes.instructions: Stir fry chopped potatoes and cauliflower florets with onions, ginger, and ground spices until tender and lightly charred.

recipes.name: Poha
recipes.instructions: Rinse flattened rice. Splutter mustard seeds, roast peanuts, sauté potatoes and onions with turmeric, toss poha, and finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Idli Sambar
recipes.instructions: Steam fermented rice-lentil batter into fluffy idlis. Simmer toor dal and chopped vegetables with sambar powder and tamarind tadka.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.instructions: Grill yogurt-spiced chicken skewers. Simmer a creamy, spiced tomato sauce and toss the roasted chicken chunks until coated.

recipes.name: Rajma Chawal
recipes.instructions: Slow cook soaked kidney beans in a spiced onion-tomato gravy until thick and tender. Serve over steaming hot basmati rice.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.instructions: Stuff spiced mashed potato filling into rolled wheat dough. Flatten carefully and shallow fry on a tawa with butter until golden brown.

recipes.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
recipes.instructions: Brown mutton in mustard oil with aromatic spices. Cook with whisked yogurt, Kashmiri chili, and fennel paste until meat is melt-in-mouth tender.

recipes.name: Upma
recipes.instructions: Roast semolina dry. Sauté mustard seeds, urad dal, curry leaves, and onions in ghee. Add water, bring to boil, and stir in rava smoothly.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
recipes.instructions: Roast whole eggplant over open flame until charred. Peel, mash, and sauté with onions, ginger, tomatoes, and basic spices.

recipes.name: Medu Vada
recipes.instructions: Soak and grind urad dal to a fluffy batter. Shape into doughnut rings and deep fry in hot oil until crunchy and golden.

recipes.name: Kadai Chicken
recipes.instructions: Cook chicken in a wok with chunky peppers, onions, and freshly ground kadai spice blend until aromatic and semi-dry.

recipes.name: Dhokla
recipes.instructions: Mix besan batter with eno and steam for 15 minutes. Pour warm sweet-tangy tempering of mustard seeds and chilies over spongy squares.

recipes.name: Fish Curry (Goan Style)
recipes.instructions: Make coconut-tamarind spice paste. Simmer paste with coconut milk, add fish slices, and cook gently for 6-8 minutes.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
recipes.instructions: Marinate cubed paneer and vegetables in spiced yogurt-mustard oil mix. Skewer and roast in oven or grill pan till charred edges appear.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
recipes.instructions: Sauté onions and puree tomatoes. Cook green peas and paneer cubes in spiced gravy until thick and flavorful.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
recipes.instructions: Cook washed rice and lentils with turmeric and salt in a pressure cooker. Temper with cumin seeds fried in ghee.

recipes.name: Chicken Korma
recipes.instructions: Cook chicken in aromatic white gravy made of fried onion puree, yogurt, and rich almond paste on low heat.

recipes.name: Pav Bhaji
recipes.instructions: Boil and mash vegetables. Cook with butter, tomatoes, and special pav bhaji masala. Serve hot with butter-toasted buns.

recipes.name: Egg Curry
recipes.instructions: Lightly fry hard-boiled eggs with turmeric. Prepare tomato-onion sauce with whole spices, simmer eggs for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Sambhar Vada
recipes.instructions: Prepare authentic tangy vegetable sambar. Soak crispy freshly fried urad dal vadas in hot piping sambar and garnish with coriander.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.instructions: Roll paneer-potato dumplings and deep fry until crisp. Make creamy cashew-tomato silk gravy and place koftas just before serving.

recipes.name: Bisi Bele Bath
recipes.instructions: Cook rice, dal, and veggies together. Blend with tamarind and freshly spiced aromatic powder, then temper with crunchy ghee cashews.

recipes.name: Prawn Curry (Kerala Style)
recipes.instructions: Cook prawns with kudampuli, curry leaves, and spicy red curry paste in an earthen pot. Stir in rich coconut milk and simmer.

recipes.name: Samosa
recipes.instructions: Make crisp pastry cones filled with spicy cumin-seasoned mashed potatoes and peas. Deep fry on medium flame until golden.

recipes.name: Bhindi Masala
recipes.instructions: Sauté chopped dry okra until non-slimy. Stir fry with sliced onions, tomatoes, and tangy dry mango spice mix.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.instructions: Slow cook black lentils and kidney beans for hours. Infuse with butter, pureed tomatoes, and finish with cream and fenugreek.

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji
recipes.instructions: Sauté chopped onions, green chilies, and tomatoes. Add seasonings and quickly toss crumbled paneer on high heat for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Chettinad
recipes.instructions: Roast whole spices and coconut, then grind into fresh Chettinad paste. Cook chicken pieces in oil with paste until dark and deeply spiced.

recipes.name: Methi Thepla
recipes.instructions: Knead flour with chopped fresh fenugreek, yogurt, and spices into soft dough. Roll thinly and roast lightly on hot skillet.

recipes.name: Kadhi Pakora
recipes.instructions: Make crisp onion gram-flour fritters. Simmer a velvety yogurt-besan stew, drop in warm pakoras, and temper with mustard and chili.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.instructions: Sauté whole spices, sliced onions, and vegetables in ghee. Add soaked basmati rice and water, pressure cook on low heat for one whistle.

recipes.name: Jeera Rice
recipes.instructions: Sizzle cumin seeds and bay leaf in ghee. Add drained soaked basmati rice, cook until fragrant, add salted water, and steam until fluffy.

recipes.name: Pani Puri
recipes.instructions: Crack open crispy puris, stuff with spiced potato filling, spoon in sweet tamarind sauce, and douse in iced tangy mint water.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
recipes.instructions: Prick and deep fry baby potatoes. Cook gently on sealed dum in a vibrant, spiced yogurt gravy without onions or garlic.

recipes.name: Mushroom Masala
recipes.instructions: Sauté sliced button mushrooms until moisture evaporates. Simmer in thick roasted onion and tomato masala sauce.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.instructions: Scramble eggs in hot wok. Add chilled rice, scallions, peas, soy sauce, and sesame oil; stir-fry vigorously on high heat.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.instructions: Chop crisp romaine lettuce, toss thoroughly with creamy Caesar dressing, top with crunchy croutons and shaved parmesan.

recipes.name: Beef Cheeseburger
recipes.instructions: Pan sear or grill beef patty, melt cheddar on top. Toast bun, spread sauce, layer lettuce, tomato, and patty.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
recipes.instructions: Toast sourdough slices. Mash ripe avocado with lemon juice and salt, spread over warm toast, and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.instructions: Cook fettuccine al dente. Melt butter with minced garlic, whisk in heavy cream and parmesan until smooth, then toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.instructions: Simmer chopped carrots and celery in chicken broth. Add noodles and shredded cooked chicken; cook until noodles are tender.

recipes.name: Falafel Wrap
recipes.instructions: Warm pita bread, spread thick hummus, place fried falafels, add diced cucumber-tomato salad, and drizzle with tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.instructions: Butter outer sides of bread, place cheeses in between, grill in a pan on medium-low heat until crisp and cheese is fully melted.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.instructions: Sauté garlic and shrimp in butter and olive oil until pink. Deglaze with lemon juice, toss with cooked linguine, and top with parsley.

recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.instructions: Whisk egg, milk, and cinnamon. Dip bread slices to coat well, then fry in melted butter until golden on both sides. Serve with syrup.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Bruschetta
recipes.instructions: Toast baguette slices rubbed with garlic. Top with diced tomatoes tossed in olive oil and basil, then drizzle balsamic glaze.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.instructions: Fill tortilla with seasoned chicken and cheese. Fold and crisp on hot pan on both sides until cheese is bubbling.

recipes.name: Beef Lasagna
recipes.instructions: Layer cooked pasta noodles with seasoned ground beef marinara, ricotta, and mozzarella cheese. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
recipes.instructions: Pan sear chicken until browned, glaze with thick teriyaki sauce. Serve over warm white rice with steamed broccoli florets.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.instructions: Stir fry noodles with protein, egg, and tamarind-based pad thai sauce. Garnish with crunchy bean sprouts, lime, and crushed peanuts.

recipes.name: Hummus & Pita Plate
recipes.instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and ice water until silky smooth. Drizzle olive oil and serve with warm pita.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.instructions: Sauté shallots and mushrooms. Slowly ladle hot broth into arborio rice, stirring constantly until creamy, then finish with butter and cheese.

recipes.name: Guacamole & Chips
recipes.instructions: Mash avocados coarsely with lime juice, stir in diced onions, tomatoes, and cilantro. Serve alongside crunchy tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
recipes.instructions: Simmer mixed garden vegetables, beans, and pasta in rich tomato herb broth until tender. Top with grated parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
recipes.instructions: Chop hard-boiled eggs and mix with mayonnaise, dijon mustard, salt, pepper, and chopped chives. Spread generously between bread.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken Wings
recipes.instructions: Season wings with spices and bake at 200C for 35 minutes until crispy. Toss with BBQ sauce and broil for 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Club Sandwich
recipes.instructions: Assemble triple-decker sandwich with toasted bread, mayo, cooked bacon, sliced poultry, lettuce, and tomatoes. Slice diagonally.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Bowl
recipes.instructions: Toss salad greens with sweet corn and flaky canned tuna. Top with sliced hard-boiled egg and light vinaigrette dressing.

recipes.name: Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
recipes.instructions: Blend frozen blueberries, banana, and almond milk into thick smoothie. Pour into bowl and decorate with chia seeds and almond flakes.

recipes.name: Beef Shepherd's Pie
recipes.instructions: Cook ground beef with vegetables and broth. Transfer to baking dish, spread buttery mashed potatoes over top, and bake until golden brown.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.instructions: Place salmon and asparagus on sheet tray, drizzle with olive oil, season with herbs and lemon slices. Bake at 200C for 14 minutes.

recipes.name: Belgian Waffles
recipes.instructions: Whisk batter until combined. Pour into preheated waffle iron and cook until golden crisp. Serve with fresh strawberries and syrup.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipes.instructions: Toss grilled chicken and romaine with caesar dressing. Lay on tortilla, sprinkle parmesan, roll tightly, and cut in half.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.instructions: Hollow bell peppers, fill with seasoned meat, rice, and beans mix. Top with cheese and bake at 180C for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
recipes.instructions: Blend mango pulp, fresh yogurt, milk, sugar, and cardamom powder until frothy and smooth. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Pulao
recipes.instructions: Cook basmati rice infused with whole aromatic spices and saffron. Fold in fried nuts, dry fruits, and fresh seasonal fruit garnishes.

recipes.name: Fish Amritsari
recipes.instructions: Marinate fish with ajwain, spices, and besan batter. Deep-fry on medium flame until golden brown and super crispy.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.instructions: Soak sabudana overnight. Sauté cumin, potato, and green chilies in ghee, fold in peanuts and tapioca pearls, and cook until translucent.

recipes.name: Gobi Manchurian (Dry)
recipes.instructions: Coat florets in cornstarch and deep fry until crisp. Toss in wok with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and scallions on high flame.

recipes.name: Chicken 65
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken in spiced curd and cornstarch batter. Deep-fry till crisp, then temper with hot curry leaves, green chilies, and garlic.

recipes.name: Rava Dosa
recipes.instructions: Make thin watery batter. Pour from height onto hot greased griddle to form lacy, thin, crispy crepe without spreading.

recipes.name: Keema Matar
recipes.instructions: Sauté minced meat with whole spices, onions, and garlic. Stir in green peas and tomato gravy; simmer until thickened.

recipes.name: Misal Pav
recipes.instructions: Cook sprouted moth beans in a spicy, fiery red gravy (kat/rassa). Garnish with chopped onions and farsan; serve with toasted pav.

recipes.name: Paneer Jalfrezi
recipes.instructions: Stir fry long slices of peppers and onions on high heat. Add spiced tomato puree and toss in paneer fingers for a semi-dry dish.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.instructions: Boil soaked chickpeas with a black tea bag. Simmer in a spicy, tangy dry mango and coriander onion gravy.

recipes.name: Lemon Rice
recipes.instructions: Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chilies, and peanuts in oil with turmeric. Mix gently into warm rice and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
ingredients: 1 cup sugar syrup flavored with rose water and cardamom
recipes.instructions: Knead dough, form small crack-free balls, deep fry slowly in ghee until dark golden, and soak in warm sugar syrup for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Gajar Ka Halwa
recipes.instructions: Simmer grated carrots in milk until milk evaporates. Sauté in ghee with sugar, cardamom, and roasted dry fruits until glossy.

recipes.name: Masala Chai
recipes.instructions: Boil crushed ginger and cardamom in water. Add black tea leaves, bring to vigorous boil, add milk and sugar, simmer, and strain.

recipes.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
recipes.instructions: Boil noodles al dente. Toss in smoking hot wok with shredded vegetables, soy sauce, and vinegar for 2 minutes on highest flame.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.instructions: Simmer spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce. Make small wells, crack whole eggs into the sauce, cover, and poach until whites set.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.instructions: Alternate slices of ripe tomatoes and fresh mozzarella on a plate. Tuck in fresh basil leaves, season with flaky salt, and drizzle olive oil.

recipes.name: Fish and Chips
ingredients: 2 large potatoes cut into thick chips
recipes.instructions: Deep fry potato chips until crisp. Dip fish fillets into cold bubbly batter, deep fry until golden brown, and serve with tartar sauce.

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.instructions: Melt dark chocolate with butter. Whisk in eggs, sugar, and flour. Pour into greased ramekins and bake at 200C for 10 minutes until center remains molten.
